title: Brewery and Distillery Golf Cart Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Hop on our Golf Cart Brewery & Distillery Tour for an unforgettable Nashville tasting adventure! This unique tour takes you to the heart of downtown's finest breweries and distilleries, all from the comfort of a lively, open-air golf cart. Over the course of two hours, we'll make stops at three to four iconic spots, with each location offering a taste of Nashville’s local craft beer, whiskey, or bourbon. At each stop, you’ll get around 20-25 minutes to explore, sample drinks, and take in the ambiance of these beloved watering holes.

Your guide doubles as both a driver and a storyteller, sharing insider knowledge about each stop’s history, specialty offerings, and fun facts about Nashville's vibrant craft scene. From traditional whiskey distilleries to innovative microbreweries, this tour is perfect for anyone looking to experience Nashville’s signature flavors. Book your seat, bring your taste buds, and prepare for a ride that pairs history with hops and heritage with high spirits!
